top_deficiency_types.title: Notify each resident of certain balances and convey resident funds upon discharge, eviction, or death.

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Meet requirements for outpatient facilities located next to inpatient facilities separated by fire resistive construction.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Set up an ongoing quality assessment and assurance group to review quality deficiencies  and develop corrective plans of action.
Ensure that residents are fully informed and understand their health status, care and treatments.
Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
